notes: The italic and before brought is added: the clause has no waw for it, and rule 42's reasoning forbids folding it into a neighbouring rendering.
whose is read as a fusion of אֲשֶׁר with the suffix on לִבּוֹ; the note names the competing reading, and the distance is allowed under rule 35 since the one word carries both senses.
The object marker and its resumptive suffix are both unrepresented, the relation being written once in whom (rules 16, 22).
